rules.why: Every card must be Neutral or from your Headquarters' faction
Your Master Plan must match your Headquarters

do.prompt: Scry: choose cards to put on the bottom (the rest stay on top)
Assign a defender (a Covert attacker allows only one)
Bloodshed: your side deals damage to which defender?
Bloodshed: your side deals damage to which attacker?
Keep this hand, or mulligan (shuffle it in, draw 5, put 1 on the bottom)?
Mulligan: put one card on the bottom of your deck

req.why: No operative can go on a mission

targets.prompt: Mission target: a Conspiracy Agenda, your Master Plan, their Master Plan, an operative (Wetwork), a Facility or Asset (Sabotage), or their Headquarters (Blackmail)

do.prompt: Lesser Imp: 1 damage to which enemy?
The New World Compact: gain 1 progress on which Agenda?
